purpose: Teach: 晒さ/信奉/軒並み/制圧/編纂/標榜/帰化/枯渇

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の名誉が世間に晒された事案、警察、慎重に対応されてますね
lines.en: In this case, I notice the police are handling the victim's exposure to public scrutiny with considerable care.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft onset on key phrases. Voice carries genuine curiosity—this is observation, not accusation. Slight upward lilt suggesting a question underneath the statement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、特定思想の信奉者による犯行を捜査します
lines.en: The police are investigating the crime as the work of individuals with a specific ideological motivation.
lines.style: Clear, official but not rigid. Each clause lands with quiet authority. No inflection waste. Professional distance maintained, but not cold—this is a man explaining his work seriously.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、商店街が軒並み被害を受けたのを警察、把握されてますね
lines.en: In this case, I'm noting that the police are aware the entire shopping district was affected by the damage.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Soft onset. Building slightly as the scope of impact becomes clear. Not accusatory—connecting dots aloud, almost to himself. Respectful pause before the observation lands.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、暴動を制圧する訓練を継続します
lines.en: The police continue to maintain and refine our riot response training protocols.
lines.style: Even-keeled, matter-of-fact. Slight emphasis on 'continue'—this is ongoing, necessary work. No defensiveness, just clarity. The voice of someone whose job is preparation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、目撃証言を編纂した報告書を作成されたんですね
lines.en: In this case, I understand the police have compiled a formal report based on witness statements.
lines.style: Softer onset. Respectful acknowledgment of thoroughness. Voice carries slight relief—this kind of systematic documentation matters. Trailing slightly upward, as if validating proper procedure.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、清廉さを標榜する組織にもメスを入れます
lines.en: The police are prepared to scrutinize even organizations that claim to uphold integrity.
lines.style: Firmer delivery. Slight hardness enters the tone—this is about principles. Each word measured and deliberate. Not accusatory, but resolved. The voice of someone stating a conviction about duty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、帰化申請に関わる詐欺を警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: In this case, I notice the police are investigating fraud related to naturalization applications.
lines.style: Observant, neutral tone. Slight emphasis on the specific crime category. Voice carries recognition of complexity—this is detailed work. Calm, methodical onset, as if cataloging another piece of a larger picture.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査資源の枯渇を防ぐ運用を続けます
lines.en: The police continue to operate in ways that prevent the depletion of our investigative resources.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. Slight weariness underneath—this is about long-term sustainability, not quick wins. Voice suggests pragmatism and foresight. Quieter ending, as if this is the lesson learned from experience.
